notes.title: 1.0.1.0 Release
notes.content:
Merry Christmas!

Following our launch we have our first update, this is a small update to address a few small fixes while we work on our larger updates to be released in the new year.


Release notes 1.0.1.0:
[list]
[*]Slightly improved first time user experience.
[*]Added reset button to scene controls.
[*]Fixed rare bug where UI could break when pressing f11 to go between full screen and windowed.
[*]Fixed issues where some user interface could be interacted with during some screen transitions.
[*]Additional quality setting options.
[*]Controller icons updates and prep for additional controller support. (Should be correct for Xbox).
[*]Disciplines added to credits.
[*]General performance improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]
